Extremely close match — same withered, uniformly brown, curled leaf against a light background. Now one reference from each other class.
Anthracnose shows a yellowed leaf with distinct lesions/spots — different from the test image. Now Powdery Mildew and Sooty Mould.

Sooty Mould shows a green leaf with dark black splotchy patches — completely different from the test image. The test image has no black coating and is fully desiccated/curled.

The evidence strongly points to **Die_Back**: the leaf is completely withered, uniformly brown, and curled upward — matching the KB description ("leaves curl upwards and fall off") and visually identical to the Die_Back reference.
